These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;134233117&amp;quot;:false,&amp;quot;134233118&amp;quot;:false,&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335551550&amp;quot;:1,&amp;quot;335551620&amp;quot;:1,&amp;quot;335559685&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559737&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:160,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:279}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK&#39;s largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering &amp;amp; Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing \u2014 that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. Your remit is the layer above that: how data is structured, governed, made available and used across the business. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work \u2014 we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic Direction&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set the vision and roadmap for data engineering, governance and reporting across THG PLC&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define how data domains (Customer, Commercial, Operations) should be structured, stored and made available for analytics, data science and AI use cases&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the relationship with Ingenuity on platform and data matters \u2014 setting requirements, managing dependencies and ensuring PLC needs are reflected in the Ingen roadmap&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Evaluate where THG should use Ingen capability versus external tooling, and ensure every technology choice is documented and commercially justified&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive the business towards a single source of truth \u2014 reducing data silos, resolving mastering conflicts, and building confidence in our data across the organisation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Engineering &amp;amp; Data Platform&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the Engineering team in building and maintaining the data pipelines, domain datasets and platform architecture that underpin analytics across Beauty and Nutrition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the evolution of our GCP\/BigQuery platform \u2014 from how data is ingested and stored, to how it is structured for downstream consumption&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set engineering standards \u2014 version control, testing, error handling, documentation \u2014 and ensure they are consistently applied&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Champion the use of AI and automation in data engineering \u2014 this is a small team that needs to move fast, and we expect the use of AI-assisted pipeline development and management to be embedded in how we work&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data Governance&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the Data Governance function from a standing start \u2014 we have no established governance framework and this is a greenfield opportunity to build it properly&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the framework for how THG manages data quality, metadata, data definitions and lineage across PLC&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with Ingenuity to ensure governance standards are consistent across both PLC and Ingen data infrastructure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build the culture and processes that make governance a positive enabler rather than a compliance burden&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Reporting &amp;amp; BI&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the consistency and quality of all business performance reporting across THG PLC \u2014 dashboards, KPI reports, executive-level views&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure that any regularly used report or dashboard is owned, maintained and built to a consistent standard \u2014 no more ad hoc reporting that lives outside a managed framework&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the evolution of our Tableau estate and assess when alternative or complementary tooling should be introduced&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Leadership &amp;amp; People&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead, develop and retain a high-performing team across three functions \u2014 Engineering, Governance and Reporting&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set clear direction and accountability for each function, developing your direct reports into leaders in their own right&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity and continuous improvement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Influence and educate senior stakeholders across the business \u2014 building data literacy and trust in data assets&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;What skills and experience do I need for this role?&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;This role is for a Data Scientist on a close-knit team supporting Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC) at RAF Mildenhall, UK. This team is at the center of helping the command empower and leverage its data for more effective analysis and decision making. As a subject matter expert, the Data Scientist will leverage their experience to gather and derive insights from complex data, assist the command with development initiatives, and facilitate digital transformation efforts. The work done in this role has a direct impact on mission readiness as the team&#39;s efforts go toward making a more resilient and data-driven organization.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;A Data Scientist will have skills sets of both data analysts and data engineers. Data scientists are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining a data pipeline. &amp;nbsp;In addition, data scientists shall interpret and analyze complex sets of data, as well as plan, execute, and manage ML projects with cloud-native platforms and advanced ML solutions. They understand some of the most challenging processes, technologies, and can leverage a vast array of methodologies in the field, such as data mining, natural language programming, and machine learning.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Data scientists must have a combination of skills that includes programming, mathematical modeling, statistics, and domain knowledge. They must combine an advanced math and statistics background with programming, domain knowledge, and communication skills to analyze data, create applied mathematical models, and present results in a form useful to the organization. &amp;nbsp;They must also be able to understand and manipulate structured and unstructured large data sets, which requires proficiency in distributed SQL programming, relational and non-relational data queries, general programming languages (such as Python and R,) and machine learning techniques.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Data Scientist shall perform the following tasks:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Interpret and analyze data using exploratory mathematic and statistical techniques based on the scientific method.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Coordinate research and analytic activities utilizing various data points (unstructured and structured) and employ programming to clean, massage, and organize the data&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Experiment against data points, provide information based on experiment results and provide previously undiscovered solutions to command data challenges.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Coordinate with Data Engineers to build Data environments providing data identified by other data professionals&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Apply and develop scientific methodology, statistics, and algorithms to discover and frame relevant problems, hypotheses, and opportunities.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Develop predictive and prescriptive modeling, natural language processing (NLP), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), text mining and processing, clustering, forecasting methods, and other advanced statistical techniques.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Design and automate processes to facilitate the manipulation and analysis of data. Manage and integrate data across dissimilar data sets. Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured data.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Use frameworks such as Spark and Hadoop to conduct large-scale data processing. Perform statistical modeling and create data visualizations using products like Tableau, Microsoft Power BI and R Shiny.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Research, design, and implement algorithms to solve complex problems. Program using R, Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) or similar analytical languages.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Perform data engineering, data processing and modeling techniques using cloud-based data management, data science, and ML platforms such as Databricks, IBM Cloud Pak, Cloudera, and Snowflake.&lt;br&gt;\u2022 &amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;Communicate complex concepts and hypothesis to a non-technical audience through digital storytelling.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A minimum of 1 year of hands-on Data Science experience is required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s Degree in a STEM field is required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficient with one or more programming languages (Java, C++, Python, R, etc.)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated ability to apply data science to solve real-world problems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Secret Clearance&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with DoD&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Master\u2019s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or related fields.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with Envision&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Salary Range: $97,000 - $233,000&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Pay Range&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.&nbsp; Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.&nbsp; Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.&nbsp; Want to join our pack?&nbsp; Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.<\/p><\/div><h2>A day in the life<\/h2>\n<p>As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.<\/p>\n<p>This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.<\/p>\n<p>You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.<\/p>\n<p>Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.<\/p>\n<p>We embrace modern development practices:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.<\/li>\n<li>We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.<\/li>\n<li>We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.<\/p>\n<p>&nbsp;<\/p>\n<h2>Your responsibilities<\/h2>\n<h3>\u00fc&nbsp; Build and maintain secure platform foundations<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.<\/li>\n<li>Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.<\/li>\n<li>Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.<\/li>\n<li>Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.<\/li>\n<li>Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>\u00fc&nbsp; Make our security controls provable<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.<\/li>\n<li>Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.<\/li>\n<li>Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.<\/li>\n<li>Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>\u00fc&nbsp; Strengthen access and identity controls<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.<\/li>\n<li>Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.<\/li>\n<li>Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>\u00fc&nbsp; Extend our platform standards beyond AWS<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.<\/li>\n<li>Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>\u00fc&nbsp; Team collaboration<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.<\/li>\n<li>Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.<\/li>\n<li>Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.<\/li>\n<li>Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h3>\u00fc&nbsp; Self development<\/h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.<\/li>\n<li>Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.<\/li>\n<li>Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Your skills and experience<\/h2>\n<p>We are looking for someone with:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).<\/li>\n<li>Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.<\/li>\n<li>Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.<\/li>\n<li>A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.<\/li>\n<li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.<\/li>\n<li>Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p>We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.<\/li>\n<li>Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>The interview process<\/h2>\n<p>This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.<\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.<\/li>\n<li>Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.<\/li>\n<li>Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.<\/li>\n<li>Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>About the team<\/h2>\n<p>The EPD (\"Engineering, Product and Design\") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.<\/p>\n<h2>Our tech stack<\/h2>\n<p>We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.&nbsp; You will be supported to learn new technology \u2013 both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.<\/p>\n<p>Our \"north star\" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.&nbsp; To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.&nbsp; We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.<\/p>\n<p>We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.&nbsp; We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.<\/p>\n<p>Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare<\/p><div class=\"content-pay-transparency\"><div class=\"title\" style=\"font-weight: 600; Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner \u00e0 chaque personne la possibilit\u00e9 d&#39;acheter ce qu&#39;elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et o\u00f9 elle le veut.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Nous sommes une entreprise ax\u00e9e sur la technologie, \u00e0 l&#39;avant-garde d\u2019un secteur qui conna\u00eet une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avan\u00e7ons rapidement, valorisons l&#39;autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles id\u00e9es et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ce que vous ferez au quotidien&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;En tant que &lt;strong&gt;Account Associate - Retail &amp;amp; Grocery (H\/F)&lt;\/strong&gt;, vous serez responsable du succ\u00e8s d\u2019un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d\u2019assurer la meilleure exp\u00e9rience \u00e0 nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures ad\u00e9quates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert \u00e0 la nouveaut\u00e9.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une soci\u00e9t\u00e9 qui \u00e9volue \u00e0 grande vitesse et \u00e0 grande \u00e9chelle. Vous aurez l\u2019opportunit\u00e9 de cr\u00e9er et am\u00e9liorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer \u00e0 la croissance. Vous \u00e9laborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes sp\u00e9cifiques et pour l&#39;ensemble du portefeuille&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Relations avec les magasins Retail et\/ou Grocery : Vous g\u00e9rerez le d\u00e9veloppement des partenariats, le suivi des donn\u00e9es, et vous assurerez une exp\u00e9rience optimale sur l\u2019application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison \u00e0 domicile de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en \u00e9tant l&#39;expert de votre zone \/ ville.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ce qu\u2019il vous faut pour r\u00e9ussir&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Exp\u00e9rience : stage ou alternance dans un r\u00f4le d\u2019Account management ou commercial. Une exp\u00e9rience terrain au sein d\u2019un grand groupe (id\u00e9alement supermarch\u00e9, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Commercial : vous avez \u00e0 c\u0153ur de n\u00e9gocier, d\u2019anticiper des discussions commerciales, d\u2019entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualit\u00e9 (discussions contractuelles, n\u00e9gociations de mise en place d&#39;outils commerciaux, etc)&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Entrepreneur : vous avez le go\u00fbt pour entreprendre, cr\u00e9er, aller chercher des opportunit\u00e9s, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre t\u00e9l\u00e9phone pour comprendre vos partenaires.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Analytique :  capable d\u2019\u00eatre synth\u00e9tique, d&#39;approfondir les donn\u00e9es et de comprendre les donn\u00e9es qui permettent d&#39;am\u00e9liorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez \u00eatre sur le terrain et vous \u00eates impliqu\u00e9(e) dans tout ce qui est op\u00e9rationnel dans votre p\u00e9rim\u00e8tre.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Centr\u00e9 sur le client : \u00eatre obs\u00e9d\u00e9 par nos clients. Utiliser des donn\u00e9es quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit op\u00e9rationnellement excellent pour nos clients.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Jouer en \u00e9quipe : un joueur d&#39;\u00e9quipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement \u00e0 tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de r\u00e9ussir avec et par les autres.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Optimiste, confiant et plein d&#39;\u00e9nergie :  vous apportez de la fra\u00eecheur, de l&#39;\u00e9nergie et de la passion dans l&#39;\u00e9quipe.  Vous contribuez \u00e0 cr\u00e9er un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles id\u00e9es et agr\u00e9able pour les autres personnes impliqu\u00e9es.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;li&gt;&lt;p&gt;Langues : Fran\u00e7ais et Anglais courant indispensables. &lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Nous sommes des passionn\u00e9s de food, des problem-solvers, des cr\u00e9ateurs de communaut\u00e9 et bien plus encore. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>The Role<\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install \u2014 all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">But the job is building and leading a team from day one \u2014 hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>What You Will Do<\/h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths \u2014 and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly \u2014 measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health \u2014 reliability starts at delivery.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>What We're Looking For<\/h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You have automated bare-metal fleets \u2014 you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. The r\u00f4le ensure strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;Data Governance Director&lt;\/strong&gt;, you will enforce global data standards, taxonomy integrity, and compliance across all luxury Maisons and markets. You will be responsible for transitioning data operations from manual checks to an automated &lt;strong&gt;Prevention\u2013Monitoring\u2013Correction&lt;\/strong&gt; framework. This role ensures strong data quality for global reporting, Optimus dashboards, and ultimately WPP Open integrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1. Data Governance &amp;amp; Taxonomy Management&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Framework &amp;amp; Model Ownership:&lt;\/strong&gt; Build, own, and execute the end-to-end Prevention\u2013Monitoring\u2013Correction data model.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Annual Taxonomy Review:&lt;\/strong&gt; Lead the yearly cycle for global taxonomy review, cleanup, and integration of new data dimensions across all Maisons.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Naming Conventions:&lt;\/strong&gt; Enforce standardized naming conventions globally, including unique Campaign IDs to enable automated campaign record aggregation via Accutics or internal systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;AdTech &amp;amp; Tracking Governance:&lt;\/strong&gt; Oversee tracking standards across server-side tagging, GA4, channel grouping governance, and migration projects (e.g., BBB \u2013 ARM Migration).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;2. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">At Ledger, we\u2019re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world\u2019s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets \u2013 including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The mission of the Senior Product Manager - Earn is to own and grow one of Ledger Live's core value pillars: helping millions of users put their crypto to work safely, directly from self-custody. You will define and drive the roadmap for Earn - spanning staking, stable yield savings, and partner-powered yield products - turning Ledger's security promise into a real, recurring source of value for our users and for the business.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What you\u2019ll be doing:<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Vision: <\/strong>Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>End-to-End Ownership: <\/strong>Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration \u2014 writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data-Driven Decision Making: <\/strong>Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Partner &amp; Ecosystem Management: <\/strong>Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what \u201cearning with Ledger\u201d means for our users.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership: <\/strong>Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance \u2014 especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Team &amp; Stakeholder Communication: <\/strong>Producing sharp, decision-ready documentation (roadmaps, product vision docs, dashboards) that can be handed directly to leadership and collaborators without further editing.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What we\u2019re looking for:<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Vision: <\/strong>Defining the vision and driving the roadmap for the Earn scope, and translating it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances new yield opportunities, platform scalability, and user trust.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>End-to-End Ownership: <\/strong>Driving initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration \u2014 writing PRDs, defining success metrics, and partnering closely with engineering, design, and embedded software to ship features that work flawlessly on both the app and the device.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data-Driven Decision Making: <\/strong>Using Mixpanel and other analytics tools to understand user behavior across the Earn funnel, identify drop-off points, and prioritize the roadmap based on evidence rather than opinion.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Partner &amp; Ecosystem Management: <\/strong>Partnering with yield and staking partners, negotiating rev-share terms, and evaluating new integrations to expand what \u201cearning with Ledger\u201d means for our users.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership: <\/strong>Acting as the central point of alignment between Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance \u2014 especially given the regulatory sensitivity of yield-generating products in crypto.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Team &amp; Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence acad\u00e9mique et impact concret.<\/span><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Vous r\u00eavez d\u2019une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorit\u00e9.<\/span><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">\u00c9nergie, environnement, proc\u00e9d\u00e9s industriels\u2026 on y con\u00e7oit des syst\u00e8mes pour produire&nbsp;<\/span><strong><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">mieux, avec moins.<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">L\u2019objectif ?&nbsp;<\/span><strong><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Limiter l\u2019impact environnemental,<\/span><\/strong><span style=\"color:#0A121E\"> r\u00e9duire la consommation \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et booster l\u2019efficacit\u00e9.<\/span><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">\ud83d\udd27&nbsp;Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos \u00e9quipes d\u00e9ploient leur cr\u00e9ativit\u00e9 scientifique pour accompagner l\u2019<\/span><strong><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">industrie du futur.&nbsp;<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Et vous, pr\u00eat\u00b7e \u00e0 innover \u00e0 nos c\u00f4t\u00e9s ?<\/span><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h3><strong>\ud83c\udfaf Ce que nous attendons de vous<\/strong><\/h3><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>En tant que chercheur postdoctoal, vous \u00eates au c\u0153ur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affect\u00e9 au centre SPIN. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez curiosit\u00e9 scientifique avec un int\u00e9r\u00eat pour l\u2019articulation entre probl\u00e9matiques de recherche fondamentale et probl\u00e9matiques indus-trielles.<\/p><p>Le centre SPIN est l\u2019un des centres de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne d\u00e9di\u00e9 \u00e0 la recherche en g\u00e9nie des proc\u00e9d\u00e9s et rassemble environ 80 personnes comprenant enseignants-chercheurs, postdocs, doctorants, stagiaires, et profite du soutien de personnels administratifs et techniques. L\u2019activit\u00e9 du centre SPIN s\u2019inscrit dans le p\u00e9rim\u00e8tre du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (UMR 5307) et du Laboratoire Environnement Ville et Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 (UMR 5600). Vous d\u00e9velopperez votre activit\u00e9 de recherche au sein du d\u00e9partement \u00ab Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s de Manipulation de la Mati\u00e8re Granulaire \u00bb (PMMG) qui concentre divers expertises scientifiques sur les proc\u00e9d\u00e9s de transformation et la caract\u00e9risa-tion de mat\u00e9riaux granulaires \u00e0 partir d\u2019approches exp\u00e9rimentales et num\u00e9riques, ainsi qu\u2019\u00e0 travers diff\u00e9rents champs disciplinaires allant de la g\u00e9om\u00e9trie math\u00e9matique \u00e0 la chimie min\u00e9rale en pas-sant par la physique des \u00e9coulements complexes. L\u2019activit\u00e9 du centre SPIN, comme du d\u00e9parte-ment PMMG, est caract\u00e9ris\u00e9e par une forte interdisciplinarit\u00e9 ainsi que par de nombreuses collabo-rations avec d\u2019autres institutions de recherche et d\u2019enseignement en Europe et dans le monde, et profite de nombreux contrats avec des partenaires industriels.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>La mati\u00e8re granulaire est un \u00e9tat de la mati\u00e8re particulier qui peine \u00e0 \u00eatre d\u00e9crit par les lois de com-portement qui s\u2019appliquent habituellement aux fluides, ou aux solides. Cependant une vaste majo-rit\u00e9 des mati\u00e8res premi\u00e8res transform\u00e9es dans de nombreux secteurs industriels, ou des produits manufactur\u00e9s, se pr\u00e9sentent sous la forme de particules solides (grains de poudre, agglom\u00e9rats, granul\u00e9s, comprim\u00e9s, etc..). La complexit\u00e9 de la dynamique de ces solides divis\u00e9s \u00e9merge du grand nombre de particules solides concern\u00e9es. En particulier dans le cas de particules solides transpor-t\u00e9es dans une conduite de transport pneumatique, o\u00f9 l\u2019\u00e9coulement d\u2019un gaz le long d\u2019une con-duite entraine les particules solides, les interactions avec les parois solides sont le si\u00e8ge de nom-breux proc\u00e9d\u00e9s physico-chimiques. Au-del\u00e0 des collisions \u00e9lastiques qui entra\u00eenent le rebond de la majorit\u00e9 des particules solides sur les parois, des processus de fragmentation, d\u2019arrachement de charges, d\u2019\u00e9chauffement local, etc. sont susceptibles de provoquer des transformations de la ma-ti\u00e8re transport\u00e9e. Dans certains cas, la formation de d\u00e9p\u00f4ts sur les parois peut \u00eatre observ\u00e9e et affecte n\u00e9gativement les performances du proc\u00e9d\u00e9 de transport.<\/p><p>Le travail attendu sera de mettre en place un montage exp\u00e9rimental capable d\u2019\u00e9tudier les proces-sus responsables de la formation de ces enrochements \u00e0 partir de mesures de pression, de d\u00e9bit, de charges \u00e9lectrostatiques, d\u2019observation par microscopie, de caract\u00e9risation granulom\u00e9trique etc. Diff\u00e9rentes poudres mod\u00e8les pourront \u00eatre utilis\u00e9es afin de reproduire les observations d\u2019enrochement report\u00e9es dans la lit\u00e9rature. L\u2019\u00e9quipe d\u2019encadrement sera constitu\u00e9e d\u2019enseignants-chercheurs du centre SPIN ainsi que d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs R&amp;D de notre partenaire industriel ORANO.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p> <br> <h3>\ud83d\udd0d Ce que nous recherchons<\/h3><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>Vous \u00eates titulaire d\u2019un :<\/p><p>\u2022 Doctorat en g\u00e9nie Innovation","title":"PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests","description":"<p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">Context:<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines\u2019 RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (\u00c9cole Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">Objective:<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">Description:<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Task 1 \u2013 Model and inverse problem. <\/strong>Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Task 2 \u2013 Validation on the MAMBO database. <\/strong>The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Task 3 \u2013 Application to flight tests. <\/strong>The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>Starting date : 01\/01\/2027<\/p> <br> <p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">Profile and application:<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and\/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python\/Matlab).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">References:<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">[1] Pereira, A. &amp; Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, <em>J. Sound Vib.<\/em>, doi:10.1016\/j.jsv.2021.116633.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">[2] Roger, M. &amp; Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, <em>J. Sound Vib.<\/em>, 453, 328-354.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">LMFA contacts:<\/span><\/strong> Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">LVA contact: <\/span><\/strong>Quentin Lecl\u00e8re (LVA, INSA Lyon)<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><strong><span style=\"color:#000099\">Funding: <\/span><\/strong>European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight)<\/p><p>Find more <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.fr\/english-speaking-jobs\">English Speaking Jobs in France<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.fr\/jobs\/companies\/centrale-innovation\/phd-inverse-modal-identification-of-free-field-radiated-noise-from-unducted-rotor-stator-stages-from-laboratory-arrays-to-open-fan-flight-tests-ecu-171367","tags":["LMFA"],"job_types":["Mid","fulltime fixed term"],"location":"Ecully, Auvergne-Rh\u00f4ne-Alpes, France","created_at":1790245804},{"slug":"senior-regulatory-cmc-consultant-saclay-254912","company_name":"Excelya","title":"Senior Regulatory CMC Consultant","description":"<p>Join Excelya, a dynamic and innovative company committed to excellence and collaboration in the field of translational research.Our global team of experts are the powerful force behind our success.
